items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Doubles Down on U.S. Housing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway nearly doubled its stake in home builder Lennar, adding to its bet on the U.S. housing industry, while confirming its position in Italian web-services firm Bending Spoons.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Lennar, Starts Bending Spoons, Trims Bank Of America In Q3
items.summary: According to the company’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, the firm’s overall equity portfolio stood at roughly $304 billion across about 30 positions as of the end of the quarter.

items.title: Here's What Berkshire Hathaway Bought and Sold in Q3
items.summary: Berkshire mostly continued where it left off in Q2. Here are all the stocks that Greg Abel & Co. added to the portfolio — and the ones they sold, too.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Stake in Lennar, Doubling Down on Its U.S. Housing Bet
items.summary: The conglomerate formerly run by Warren Buffett also trimmed stakes in Capital One and Nucor during the September quarter.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Slashes This Top 5 Stock; Nvidia Boosts SpaceX
items.summary: Details of Berkshire Hathaway's Q3 buys and sells came in a 13F filing after Monday's close.

items.title: Berkshire Sold Bank of America and VeriSign Stock in Q3, and Bought Lennar and Delta
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway reduced its Bank of America stake by 27.5 million shares in the third quarter, according to an SEC filing.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Nearly Doubled Its Stake in One Homebuilder Last Quarter. It Now Owns 26 Million Shares
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new 13F shows 26,034,436 Class A shares of Lennar on September 30, up from 13,111,741 three months earlier.

items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Just Revealed a New Stock and Sold More Bank of America. Here’s What a 68-Year-Old With 400 Shares Owns
items.summary: Berkshire's 13F shows a new stake in Bending Spoons, a near doubling of Lennar and a $1.5 billion cut to Bank of America. Here's what a 68-year-old with 400 Berkshire shares in her IRA owns.
